title: sieve-native/evaluator: str_contains allocates two lowercased Strings per call
description: crates/sieve-native/src/evaluator.rs str_contains() — when casemap=true, both haystack and needle are fully lowercased via to_ascii_lowercase(), allocating two new Strings on every match attempt. For the common case where casemap is the default (i;ascii-casemap), every header check in eval_header_test allocates. A memchr-style case-insensitive search over bytes or using str::contains with a char predicate would avoid allocations entirely.
